Hi there 👋 Welcome to my Homepage!

I am a Master of Economics student at The University of Hong Kong (2026–2028). I received my undergraduate degree in Data Science and Big Data Technology from Shanghai University of Finance and Economics (2022–2026).

Previously, I interned at ByteDance TikTok Shop, focusing on strategy and market analysis in Southeast Asia. My other internships span financial research, risk control, and financial digitalization. I am interested in business analytics, recommendation systems, agent-based simulation, and applied AI.

Feel free to get in touch to discuss data, research, or collaboration.

Yubo Chen · Research project

Learning Dynamic Reading Interests with Sequential Recommendation

A hybrid book recommendation model built on 6 million user–book interactions. Explored NCF, DeepFM, and DCN, then used BERT4Rec and data augmentation to capture evolving interests.
